title: Pin a cable with sandbags at the marks
instruction: Lay the black cable straight inside the yellow taped lane, then pin it with the sandbags: put one sandbag on top of the cable at each of the three red marks. Let go of the cable and the bags.
context: Temporary cable runs along walkways and outdoor sites are kept out of the walking path and weighed down so foot traffic and wind cannot shift them into the path, a trip and cord-damage hazard under workplace safety rules; AV technicians, who install and position event equipment (O*NET 27-4011.00), lay such runs. One hand keeps the cable straight in the lane while the other sets weights on a thin, round cable, near end first.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x away from the robot, y to its left). Stage box: grey steel box 8x6x6 cm (x,y,z), fixed, centre x 34.5, y 36. Cable: black 6 mm round PVC cord, 55 cm, leaves the box's -y face through a grommet at x 34.5, y 32.4 (held there, free to swing sideways); black 35x16x12 mm plug body (15 g) on its free end. It lies straight, swung 22 deg towards the robot from -y, plug at about x 13, y -21. Lane: two yellow 10 mm tape strips, 61 cm long from the box face along -y, inner edges at x 32.5 and 36.5 (40 mm lane). Red tape marks 110x6 mm across the lane at y 17.4, 2.4, -12.6 (15, 30, 45 cm from the exit). Sandbags: olive-drab canvas, sand-filled, 50x40x25 mm, 80 g, at x 16, y 25; x 16, y 17; x 45, y -26 (beyond the far side of the lane end).
scoring: At the end, ruler and top photo. Score 0 if: a gripper is within 3.5 cm of the cable, plug or any sandbag; less than 90% of the cable length (exit to plug) lies inside the lane (centreline within the 40 mm between the tapes); or the stage box was moved. Otherwise +1/3 per red mark with a sandbag resting on the cable: the cable runs under the bag at least 5 mm in from its edges, the bag's bottom (at its middle) is 2-12 mm above the table (lifted by the cable, not flat beside it or on another bag), and its centre is within 2 cm of the mark along the lane. One bag counts for one mark.
reset_notes: Put the three sandbags back on their tape outlines (x 16, y 25; x 16, y 17; x 45, y -26, beyond the far side of the lane end). Lay the cable straight from the grommet to the tape mark for the plug at x 13, y -21 (22 deg off the lane), plug flat. Stage box and tape stay in place.
fidelity: Cable: 2 cm rigid segments with bending springs, no twist or plasticity, friction 0.8; pinned on a vertical pivot at the exit (real: snug grommet). Sandbags are rigid 80 g boxes: a real sandbag drapes over the cable, the sim box rests flat or tilted on it, so 'resting on' is judged by the lift of its bottom (2-12 mm). Tape and marks are 0.3-0.4 mm fixed boxes.
